name: Five
description_en:
Five builds and deploys database-backed business web applications. Its current positioning includes V, an AI development assistant, while its published manual tutorials demonstrate relational tables, forms, SQL queries, roles and charts. An application developer works in the builder; an end-user consumes the deployed application, with different commercial allowances.

The same-domain vendor walkthroughs provide concrete operating examples without relying on the inaccessible authority encoding for help.five.org. They are historical tutorials, so their menus and behavior are examples to verify against the current product. No current-version equivalence, isolation guarantee or successful deployment is inferred.
description_zh:
Five 构建和部署数据库驱动的业务 Web 应用，当前定位包含 AI 开发助手 V，公开手动教程则展示关系表、表单、SQL 查询、角色和图表。开发者使用构建环境，终端用户使用已部署应用，商业额度不同。

同域官方实操教程提供了具体例子，不依赖当前结构无法表示的 help.five.org 来源。这些是历史教程，菜单及行为需与当前产品核对；未推断版本完全等同、隔离保证或部署成功。

core_features.explanation_en: The tutorial connects modeled relational tables to generated forms.
core_features.explanation_zh: 教程将建模关系表连接到生成表单。

core_features.explanation_en: The front-end example maps a search input to a SQL parameter rather than an unfiltered list.
core_features.explanation_zh: 前端示例将搜索输入映射为 SQL 参数，而非无过滤列表。

core_features.explanation_en: V assists application generation; token use has separate commercial conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: V 辅助生成应用，token 使用另有商业条件。

en: Reproduce a two-partner portal using synthetic contacts and timesheets.
Verify parameterized search and budget the chosen deployment/user/token combination.
zh: 用模拟联系人和工时复现双伙伴门户。
验证参数化搜索，并预算所选部署／用户／token 组合。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose a trial or plan and a disposable relational dataset; reproduce one table-to-form flow.
steps.zh: 选择试用或方案及可丢弃关系数据，复现一个表到表单流程。

steps.en: Test two user scopes, query parameters and deployment targets before adding AI generation.
steps.zh: 启用 AI 生成前测试两个用户范围、查询参数及部署目标。

items.en: The published manual walkthroughs are historical and not a current-version compatibility test.
items.zh: 公开手动教程为历史资料，并非当前版本兼容性测试。

items.en: A trial’s development access does not automatically include AI token credit.
items.zh: 试用开发访问不自动包含 AI token 额度。

pricing.summary_en: Five publishes per-app monthly billing with $27.49/$29.99 displayed choices, ten end-users and3GB/app in the starter offer. Developer seats, higher user/resource tiers and AI token top-ups are separate considerations. Trial AI credits and a signup-credit table row conflict; final billing selection, full license and total cost remain unverified.
pricing.summary_zh: Five 按应用／月报价，展示 $27.49／$29.99，入门方案含十终端用户和每应用 3GB。开发席位、更高用户／资源档位及 AI token 充值另行考虑。试用无 AI 额度与注册额度表格存在差异；最终计费选择、完整许可及总价待核。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

research_gaps.en: This draft cites actual five.co vendor tutorials. Their historical examples have not been reconciled with every current help.five.org v3 behavior.
research_gaps.zh: 本草稿引用实读 five.co 官方教程，历史示例尚未与 help.five.org v3 的全部当前行为对应。

research_gaps.en: No application, account, user role, query, deployment, data transfer or purchase was executed. Current-version behavior, permissions, backup/export and recovery remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行应用、账户、角色、查询、部署、数据传输或购买。当前版本行为、权限、备份／导出及恢复待核。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Proposed examples were not executed.

sections.en: The vendor’s portal walkthrough models business partners, contacts and timesheets, then builds forms and a menu. It checks the database model before extending the UI. Use a small relational fixture and verify foreign-key relationships before adding automation; a generated form alone does not establish that the data model represents the business process correctly.
sections.zh: 官方门户教程先建业务伙伴、联系人及工时表，再建表单、菜单，并在扩展 UI 前检查数据库模型。应使用小型关系数据样本，添加自动化前核对外键；生成表单本身不能证明数据模型正确表达业务流程。

sections.title_en: Treat the tutorial’s user binding as a testable example
sections.title_zh: 将教程用户绑定作为待验证实例
sections.en: The portal example creates a business-partner role with connection/query/table CRUD grants and associates a user with one partner record. Its timesheet chart query also receives that partner key as a parameter. These are distinct parts of the example. Verify list, form and query access with two test partners instead of assuming a hidden menu alone enforces row isolation.
sections.zh: 门户示例建立含连接／查询／表 CRUD 权限的角色，并将用户关联一个伙伴记录；工时图查询也接收该伙伴 key。两者是不同环节，应使用两个测试伙伴核对列表、表单及查询访问，不能认为隐藏菜单即可执行行隔离。

sections.title_en: Connect the input parameter to the actual query
sections.title_zh: 将输入参数接到真实查询
sections.en: The dated database-front-end guide adds a parameterized WHERE condition to a book search, then defines the parameter and its expression. Test a known match, no match and unusual input before using a similar search. The tutorial demonstrates a query/UI connection, not a complete proof of every database or injection-defense behavior in the current release.
sections.zh: 历史数据库前端指南给图书搜索增加参数化 WHERE，再定义参数及表达式。复用类似搜索前应测试已知匹配、无匹配及特殊输入。教程演示查询与 UI 连接，不证明当前版本全部数据库或注入防护行为。

sections.title_en: Previewing a tutorial is not production acceptance
sections.title_zh: 教程预览不等于生产验收
sections.en: The walkthrough uses development deployment and a separate Run preview. Current pricing describes containerized cloud deployment and distinct development, testing and production targets. Keep test records and credentials disposable, and independently verify data migration, rollback and recovery. The historical tutorial’s interface is not evidence that the current AI builder uses identical steps.
sections.zh: 教程区分开发部署与 Run 预览，当前价格 FAQ 描述容器化云部署以及开发、测试、生产目标。测试数据和凭据应可丢弃，并另行核对数据迁移、回退与恢复。历史界面不能证明当前 AI 构建器步骤完全相同。

sections.title_en: Budget app, users and AI separately
sections.title_zh: 分别预算应用、用户及 AI
sections.en: The current page bills per application/month and displays $27.49 and $29.99 options alongside annual/monthly choices, with ten end-users and3GB/app in the starter deployment offer. Higher plans change resources and seats. The FAQ says trials exclude AI credits and paid plans include $5; a separate signup-credit row needs clarification. No final checkout or unlimited-user entitlement was established.
sections.zh: 当前页按应用／月计费，在年付／月付选择旁展示 $27.49、$29.99，入门部署含十终端用户及每应用 3GB。较高方案改变资源和席位。FAQ 说明试用无 AI 额度、付费含 $5，另一个注册额度行仍需澄清。未确认最终结算或无限用户权益。
